definitions.c_without_asm_pragmas: C file exists with no textual INCLUDE_ASM pragma; not proof of correctness or portability.
definitions.native_observed: Compile database output exists and is no older than its C source; headers, successful linking and runtime are separate evidence.
definitions.constructor_candidates: Class identifiers, comments and selected C/assembly symbols are recovery leads, not verified address bindings.
definitions.scope: Main and VR stage tables, uninitialized-memory manifest names, and every OVERLAY comparison in the linker template; no retail bytes are read or emitted.
